package com.oveduumnakal.snakeweed;

/** Where a 3-tick search stands for the click-away prompt. */
enum SearchPhase
{
	/** Nothing to prompt: no search is waiting on its result, or the herb was found. */
	IDLE,

	/** The search came up empty. The player has this one tick to click away before the manual search starts. */
	DECISION,

	/** The player did not click away in time and the uncancellable manual search animation began. */
	MISSED
}

package com.oveduumnakal.snakeweed;

/** What the plugin knows about whether a vine can be searched. */
enum VineState
{
	/** The vine is ripe and can be searched. */
	RIPE,

	/** The vine was seen being picked, so when it regrows is known. */
	PICKED,

	/** The vine was first seen already picked, so when it regrows is only an estimate. */
	UNKNOWN
}
